### FHIR and Generative AI Resources

| Resource Name               | Resource Description | Author |
|-----------------------------|----------------------|--------|
| [**Cumulus**](https://smarthealthit.org/cumulus/) | Turnkey functions to annotate FHIR data for analytics, de-identify data, and query for cohorts. Uses FHIR APIs and NLP/LLMs to process population data for care, research, and public health.<br>**SMART on FHIR, FHIR Bulk Access, Information Extraction, Data sharing, Data analysis, Federated networks** | **SMART on FHIR (Boston Children's Hospital)**<br>The SMART Health IT project develops open technologies for digital health. |
| [**FHIR-GPT**](https://ai.nejm.org/doi/10.1056/AIcs2300301) | Converts clinical narratives into FHIR resources using large language models. Developed FHIR-GPT for transforming clinical texts into FHIR medication statements.<br>**FHIR, Few-Shot Learning** | **Northwestern University, Siemens Healthineers**<br>Peer-reviewed research from Northwestern and Siemens Healthineers. |
| [**Vertex AI Agent Builder**](https://cloud.google.com/generative-ai-app-builder/docs/create-data-store-hc) | Build AI agents and applications using natural language or a code-first approach.<br>**Development tool** | **Alphabet**<br>Services for production tools using Google Cloud Platform. |
| [**LLM-FHIR-Eval**](https://github.com/flexpa/llm-fhir-eval) | Framework to benchmark LLMs on FHIR-specific tasks like generation, validation, and extraction.<br>**FHIR, LLMs, Benchmarking, Evaluation** | **Flexpa**<br>Developer of APIs for claims and health data. |
| [**RAG on FHIR**](https://github.com/samschifman/RAG_on_FHIR) | Uses Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to combine FHIR with Generative AI.<br>**FHIR, Retrieval Augmented Generation** | **Independently developed**<br>Independent project. |
| [**LLM on FHIR**](https://github.com/StanfordBDHG/LLMonFHIR) | Interprets, summarizes, and explains health record data using OpenAI GPT and FHIR.<br>**FHIR, Digital Health, Mobile Apps, LLMs** | **Stanford Biodesign Digital Health Group**<br>Develops digital health solutions and modular, interoperable tools. |
| [**HealthGPT**](https://github.com/StanfordBDHG/HealthGPT) | iOS app that lets users interact with Apple Health data using natural language.<br>**FHIR, Digital Health, Mobile Apps, LLMs** | **Stanford Biodesign Digital Health Group**<br>Develops digital health solutions and modular, interoperable tools. |
| [**HealthChain**](https://github.com/dotimplement/HealthChain) | Open-source framework for scalable AI and NLP apps in healthcare.<br>**EHR Integration, NLP, Testing and Evaluation, Pipeline** | **dotimplement**<br>Builds dev tools and consults on healthcare AI. |
| [**Doctor Dok**](https://github.com/CatchTheTornado/doctor-dok) | Secure open-source framework for storing and managing medical records via LLMs.<br>**Storage, Digitization, LLM Query and Summarization** | **Catch the Tornado**<br>Open-source framework for record management. |
| [**pyomop**](https://github.com/dermatologist/pyomop) | Python library to query OMOP CDM databases and convert results to DataFrames. Uses Llama Index.<br>**FHIR, OMOP, Query and Analysis** | **Independently developed**<br>Independent project. |
| [**MEDPrompt**](https://github.com/329162516/medprompt) | Prompt tools including FHIR2Text, which converts FHIR to plain text.<br>**Text Conversion** | **Independently developed**<br>Independent project. |
| [**IRIS FHIRfy**](https://github.com/jrpereirajr/iris-fhirfy) | Converts raw data into FHIR resources using InterSystems IRIS platform and LLMs.<br>**FHIR Resource Generator** | **Independently developed from Intersystems template**<br>Independent project. |

### NIH-Supported FHIR Tools

| Resource Name                     | Resource Description | Author | Funding                |
|-----------------------------------|----------------------|--------|------------------------|
| [**LHC FHIR tools**](https://lhcforms.nlm.nih.gov/) | Web tools including the LHC-Forms Widget for rendering FHIR Questionnaires and producing QuestionnaireResponses and Observations.<br>**FHIR tools, widgets, services** | **NLM**<br>Developed by and hosted at the National Library of Medicine. | NIH                    |
| [**DbGaP FHIR API**](https://github.com/ncbi/DbGaP-FHIR-API-Docs) | API returning Bundles of ResearchStudy FHIR resources from dbGaP.<br>**FHIR API** | **NCBI dbGaP project**<br>dbGaP is the Database of Genotypes and Phenotypes. | NCBI                   |
| [**NIH Cloud Lab**](https://cloud.nih.gov/resources/cloudlab/) | Cloud services open to the NIH biomedical research community.<br>**Cloud system support** | **NIH STRIDES Initiative**<br>NIH STRIDES partners with commercial cloud providers. | NIH                    |
| [**FAIR4Health**](https://github.com/fair4health) | GitHub repositories applying FAIR principles in health research using FHIR.<br>**CDM model, data curation and privacy tools, FHIR IG** | **European Union Horizon 2020**<br>EU research and innovation program (2014–2020). | HL7 Europe             |
| [**Sync for Science (S4S)**](https://syncfor.science/) | FHIR API enabling research participants to share clinical data like labs, meds, vitals, and documents.<br>**FHIR API** | **NIH, ONC, Harvard Med School**<br>Collaboration among agencies, providers, and EHR vendors. | All of Us              |
| [**FhirExtinguisher**](https://github.com/JohannesOehm/FhirExtinguisher) | Tool that flattens FHIR Bundles for statistical analysis.<br>**Converter** | **Univ. of Münster, Germany**<br>Independent academic project. | BMBF (HiGHmed/Münster) |
| [**NLP2FHIR**](https://github.com/BD2KOnFHIR/NLP2FHIR) | FHIR-based clinical data normalization pipeline.<br>**Converter** | **Mayo Clinic**<br>BD2K initiative project. | —                      |
| [**FHIR PIT**](https://researchsoftwareinstitute.github.io/data-translator/apps/fhir-pit) | Combines clinical + environmental data and removes PHI to create integrated datasets.<br>**Converter** | **UNC Health Care System**<br>Data Translator program participant. | —                      |
| [**REDMATCH (FHIRCAT)**](https://github.com/aehrc/redmatch) | REDCap module for exporting data as FHIR resources.<br>**Converter** | **Australian Genomics**<br>REDCap integration tool. | NHMRC (GNT1113531)     |
| [**FHIR Ontology External Module**](https://github.com/aehrc/redcap_fhir_ontology_provider) | REDCap external module for referencing FHIR ontology servers.<br>**REDCap module** | **Australian e-Health Research Centre**<br>CSIRO + Queensland Government initiative. | —                      |
| [**EBMonFHIR**](https://confluence.hl7.org/spaces/CDS/pages/49645940/EBMonFHIR) | IG for exchanging computable scientific knowledge and creating derivative guides.<br>**FHIR IG** | **HEvKA**<br>The Health Evidence Knowledge Accelerator, formerly COKA. | —                      |
| [**FHIR to CDISC Mapping IG**](https://hl7.org/fhir/uv/cdisc-mapping/) | Maps FHIR R4 to CDISC standards (SDTMIG, CDASH, LAB).<br>**FHIR IG** | **HL7 and CDISC**<br>Promotes clinical research data interoperability. | —                      |
| [**Vulcan**](https://build.fhir.org/ig/HL7/vulcan-rwd/) | Defines a minimal set of research-ready FHIR resources for EHR systems.<br>**FHIR IG** | **HL7 Accelerator**<br>HL7 project to advance FHIR in clinical research. | —                      |
| [**MedMorph**](https://build.fhir.org/ig/HL7/fhir-medmorph-research-dex-ig/index.html) | Standardizes data partner onboarding and data sharing with research networks.<br>**FHIR IG** | **MedMorph (CDC/HHS)**<br>Enables access to clinical data using HL7 FHIR and CQL. | HHS, CDC               |
| [**ClinicalTrials.gov FHIR API**](https://clinicaltrials.gov/data-api/fhir) | Enables trial search, patient matching, and results extraction via FHIR.<br>**FHIR API** | **ClinicalTrials.gov**<br>Global clinical trial database and service. | NLM                    |
| [**FEvIR Platform**](https://fevir.net/) | Suite of tools to create, convert, and visualize FHIR representations of evidence and knowledge.<br>**FHIR tool collection** | **HEvKA**<br>Open virtual group for evidence interoperability standards. | Computable Publishing  |

### Common Data Model (CDM) and FHIR Harmonization

| Resource Name                         | Resource Description | Related CDMs                                           | Author |
|---------------------------------------|----------------------|--------------------------------------------------------|--------|
| [**CDM - FHIR Gap Analysis**](https://data2health.github.io/data-harmonization/pages/CDM-FHIR.html) | List of mappings between FHIR and CDMs: ACT(i2b2) to FHIR, OMOP to FHIR, and PCORnet(v4.1) to FHIR.<br>**Documentation for Mappings** | i2b2, OMOP, PCORnet                                    | **Data Harmonization Project (CD2H)**<br>Identifies tools and frameworks to harmonize clinical data using FAIR principles. |
| [**Federated Data Query Workshop**](https://data2health.github.io/data-harmonization/pages/BaltimoreWorkshop.html) | Presentations, videos, and slides from a 2-day workshop on federated queries and data harmonization.<br>**Educational** | i2b2, OMOP, PCORnet                                    | **Data Harmonization Project**<br>Hosted by CD2H as part of the Next Gen Data Repository Core initiative. |
| [**Data Model Harmonization Subgroup**](https://confluence.hl7.org/display/OOF/Data+Model+Harmonization) | HL7–OHDSI working group minutes and documents focused on mapping, ETL specs, adoption, and expanding use cases.<br>**Educational** | OMOP                                                   | **FHIR-OMOP Collaborative**<br>HL7 & OHDSI partnership to integrate OMOP and FHIR into a unified CDM. |
| [**FHIR-OMOP Collaborative**](https://confluence.hl7.org/display/OOF) | Central hub for meeting minutes, documentation, and announcements.<br>**Educational** | OMOP                                                   | **FHIR-OMOP Collaborative**<br>Ongoing collaboration between HL7 and OHDSI. |
| [**ASPE Code Map Services**](https://aspe.hhs.gov/code-map-services-interoperability-common-data-models-0) | Automated code mapping tools for OMOP, Sentinel, PCORNet, i2b2/ACT, TriNetX, and CDISC SDTM.<br>**Mapping Service** | OMOP, Sentinel, PCORnet, i2b2/ACT, TriNetX, CDISC SDTM | **—**<br>U.S. HHS ASPE initiative. |
| [**LinuxForHealth FHIR IG**](https://linuxforhealth.github.io/cdm-fhir-ig/index.html) | Common Data Model IG supporting data interoperability across healthcare systems.<br>**FHIR IG** | LinuxForHealth CDM                                     | **—**<br>Developed by the LinuxForHealth team. |
| [**PGHD CDM to FHIR**](https://github.com/HIRC-SNUBH/PGHD-CDMtoFHIR) | Converter from SNUBH CDM to FHIR, including an API and visualization tool.<br>**FHIR IG** | SNUBH CDM                                              | **—**<br>Seoul National University Bundang Hospital (SNUBH). |
| [**FHIR-to-OMOP Cookbook**](https://github.com/CodeX-HL7-FHIR-Accelerator/fhir2omop-cookbook) | Guide for mapping FHIR resources to OMOP CDM with examples, use cases, and comparison of design principles.<br>**Cookbook** | OMOP                                                   | **—**<br>Developed under the CodeX HL7 FHIR Accelerator. |
| [**REDHotOMOP**](https://github.com/salvolpe/REDHotOMOP/) | Converter plugin to map between OMOP and FHIR for clinical trial data inside REDCap.<br>**Plug-in Module in REDCap** | OMOP                                                   | **—**<br>Independent project. |
